notes: High-throughput adtech marketplace. Core requirement: sub-50ms p95 for recommendation API during auctions (window for decision ~60ms). Cost-sensitive — must show >=40% unit cost reduction vs current CPU cluster. Interested specifically in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching profiles, prefix/KV caching to improve hit-rate on repeat user contexts, and int8/int4 quantization options for Mistral style models. CTO quote: "If we lose latency SLAs we lose bid revenue — need reproducible perf numbers and deterministic fallbacks." POC asks: provide benchmark harness, per-route tracing, token-level cost breakdown, and ability to pin quantized model variants. detailed_requirements: SLOs: p95 latency <= 50ms (target 30-40ms) for recommendation endpoint under peak auction load
Throughput: sustain bursts to 10k req/s, average 3-4k req/s
Payloads: typical context 400-2k tokens, tail up to 4k tokens for longer sessions
Caching: require prefix/KV cache with hit-rate > 60% on personalization keys
Batching: need guidance on optimal batch sizes to trade latency vs throughput per GPU
Quantization: evaluate int8 and int4 profiles for open models (Mistral/LLAMA variants) for 2x-3x perf improvement without >3% quality degradation
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, tracing to attribute slow tails
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants during capacity pressure
Compliance: SOC2 report + KMS integration + optional EU data residency
